## GAP\_COLOR variable

Neutral fill for gap characters (`-`<!-- -->). Light/dark pair, because canvas rendering can't fall back to a CSS theme token the way SVG can — see [residueColor()](./core.residuecolor.md)<!-- -->'s `darkMode` argument.

**Signature:**

```typescript
GAP_COLOR: {
    readonly light: "#f4f4f4";
    readonly dark: "#2a2a2a";
}
```
